meta_description: JLM Decorating Services in Southampton. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, local, reliable. Call 07722 028706.
hero_eyebrow: Local Painter & Decorator — Quality Finishes, Fair Prices
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right. From a single room refresh to full house redecoration, we deliver professional finishes that last.
services_subhead: Whether you need interior redecorating, exterior painting, or specialist finishes, we've got the skills and experience to transform your space.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Fresh walls, ceilings, and woodwork throughout your home. We prep properly, use premium paints, and leave your rooms spotless — no job too small or large.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for your home's fascia, soffit, and cladding. We work in all seasons and protect your property during the job.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging and feature wall design. We source quality wallcoverings and fit them flawlessly, with attention to pattern matching and corners.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and fitted furniture finished to perfection. Sanding, painting, staining — we achieve the look you want.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Offices, shops, and business premises redecorated on schedule and to budget. We work out of hours to minimise disruption to your business.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Repair
services.desc: Proper prep work is everything. We repair damp patches, fill holes and cracks, and sand surfaces for a flawless, long-lasting finish.

about_pullquote: We do the job properly, take pride in the detail, and treat your home with respect.
about_para_1: JLM Decorating Services has been serving Southampton homes and businesses for over 15 years. We started out because we believed there was a gap for decorators who turn up on time, do the job right, and don't disappear halfway through. That's still our approach today. We've transformed over 2,000 homes across Southampton and the surrounding areas, and we've built our reputation on honest pricing and quality finishes.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen to what they want, we protect their homes during the work, and we're tidy and professional. We source the right paints and materials for the job — not the cheapest, the right ones. That's why homeowners trust us with everything from a bedroom refresh to a complete house redecoration.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the hallway and living room done. Took his time with prep work, didn't cut corners. The finish is immaculate and he cleaned up brilliantly afterwards. Highly recommend JLM, proper professional.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: We were nervous about having the whole house redecorated but he gave us a realistic timeline and stuck to it. Price was fair, the team were polite, and the quality is spot on. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Rebecca M.

reviews.text: Came out for a free quote, explained everything clearly, no pressure. Got started within a week and finished the exterior and two bedrooms without any drama. Best decorator we've used.
reviews.author: Michael H.
